Refresh **http://maker:4001** — each link now has an **Archive** action, and there's a **View archive** button at the top right of your collection.

**This is flow 5 — archiving to keep things without cluttering.** Please try:

1. On any link in your collection, click **Archive** at the bottom of the entry. Notice it disappears from the main list right away.
2. Click **View archive** (top right). You'll see your archived links, including two older reference items I put there. Notice your search box and topics still work in here.
3. On an archived link, click **Restore to collection** — then click **Back to collection** and confirm it's returned to the main view.

What I decided here — please check each:

- **Archived links leave your main view entirely** but are fully kept — you reach them through "View archive," which is itself searchable and filterable by topic.
- **Archived links do *not* show up when you search your main collection** — the archive is a separate space, so it stays out of the way. When you want an archived link, you go into the archive and search there. Tell me if you'd instead expect a main-view search to also surface archived links.
- **The archive shows a count** on the button so you know how many are tucked away.

Does this match "retain without cluttering" — and is keeping the archive as a separate search space right, or would you want your everyday search to reach into archived links too?
